description.de: Download-Automatik für IRC-Ankündigungen und RSS-Feeds: Filtert Releases in Echtzeit und übergibt passende Torrents an Transmission. Läuft über den Systemdienst autobrr (Administratoren, ShareOS 0.2.0-beta.9+).
description.en: Download automation for IRC announces and RSS feeds: filters releases in real time and hands matching torrents to Transmission. Runs via the autobrr system service (admins, ShareOS 0.2.0-beta.9+).
description.pt: Automação de downloads para anúncios IRC e feeds RSS: filtra releases em tempo real e entrega torrents correspondentes ao Transmission. Executado via serviço de sistema autobrr (administradores, ShareOS 0.2.0-beta.9+).
